extracted.intended_audience: systematic reviewers, meta-researchers, and authors preparing or reporting systematic reviews
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance about how to identify and report the platforms, interfaces, URLs, and date coverage for bibliographic and other sources when conducting systematic reviews; the page describes a study that will systematically collect and assess these items for sources listed in the Cochrane Handbook.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA: specify sources, platform/interface, URL, and date of coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: According to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) statement, all sources searched (such as MEDLINE, Embase), the interface or platform through which each source was searched (such as PubMed, Ovid), the Uniform Resource Locator (URL) and the date of coverage (where this information is provided) should be specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report each database or source name (e.g., MEDLINE, Embase), the exact interface or platform used (e.g., PubMed, Ovid), include the URL for the source when available, and state the date range or coverage date (or the date the search was run). Use PRISMA reporting to ensure transparency and reproducibility. Examples given: MEDLINE/Embase as sources and PubMed/Ovid as interfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collect platforms, URLs, time coverage, and related data for Cochrane-listed sources
rubrics_metrics.description: The primary objective of the study will be to collect platforms, URLs, time coverage and data related of the sources to search listed in the Cochrane Handbook, through a systematic web searching.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systematically search the web to identify, record and collate for each source listed in the Cochrane Handbook: the platform(s) through which it is accessed, canonical URL(s), documented time coverage or date ranges, and any related metadata or data fields. This collection enables assessment of availability and reporting practices and supports reproducible reporting in systematic reviews.
